objective: provide a reusable and controlled kkFileView-based preview capability

requirements.statement: run kkFileView as a pinned independent service
only preview platform-generated MinIO URLs and reject unsafe inputs
provide authenticated upload, preview and delete APIs
provide a reusable frontend preview component and interactive component showcase
keep existing startup behavior when preview is disabled

architecture.frontend: shared UiFilePreview component used by ComponentShowcaseView
architecture.source_policy: no arbitrary client URL; only MinIO presigned URLs created after authenticated upload
